  "phoneNote": "The restrained typography reads clearly, but repeated contact and directions sections make the lower page unnecessarily long.",
  "desktopNote": "The editorial typography feels professional, but the oversized headline and large empty bands weaken the page’s hierarchy and rhythm.",

  "fixes": [
    "Merge “Kje nas najdete” and “Obiščite nas” into one contact section with a single address and directions link; keep the footer focused on company and legal information.",
    "Reduce the desktop hero headline and section padding, and shrink the oversized map-consent panel to eliminate large empty bands.",
    "On phone, remove the extra hero call link alongside the required fixed contact controls, make the services link secondary, and tighten the space before the year section."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop: “Obiščite nas” repeats the address and directions block immediately after “Kje nas najdete”."
  ]
